description_en: Modifies meal application data in Alibaba Business Travel. This operation is typically used to synchronize meal application data
description_zh: 通过调用本接口实现在阿里商旅中修改用餐申请单数据，通常用于用餐申请单数据的同步
name: MealApplyModify

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the third-party approval form.
Enter a unique identifier, which will be displayed in the applications, orders, and bills of Alibaba Business Travel
parameters.help_zh:
三方审批单Id
建议录入唯一标识，会在阿里商旅的申请单、订单、账单中展示
parameters.name: third_part_apply_id

parameters.help_en: The status of the application form
parameters.name: status

fields.help_en:
The ID of the employee.
Enter the user_id of the Alibaba Business Travel employee
fields.help_zh:
员工Id
需录入商旅员工“user_id”
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en:
The code of the city.
Only cities in the Chinese mainland are supported. Cities in Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China) are not supported.
For city codes, refer to Six-character codes for domestic cities (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-hotel-city-data.xlsx)
fields.help_zh:
城市编码
仅支持中国大陆城市（中国港澳台均不支持）。
城市code参照国内城市六字码数据 (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-hotel-city-data.xlsx)
fields.name: city_code

fields.help_en:
The end time. The time parameter must be a string in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format.

Time zone: China
fields.help_zh:
结束时间（时间参数填写必须为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 字符串格式）

时区：中国
fields.name: end_date

fields.help_en:
The start time. The time parameter must be a string in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format.

Time zone: China
fields.help_zh:
开始时间（时间参数填写必须为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 字符串格式）

时区：中国
fields.name: start_date

fields.help_en:
The ID of the third-party itinerary.
Enter a unique identifier, which will be displayed in the applications, orders, and bills of Alibaba Business Travel
fields.help_zh:
第三方行程Id
建议录入唯一标识，会在阿里商旅的申请单、订单、账单中展示
fields.name: thirdpart_itinerary_id

parameters.help_en:
The meal quota.
Currency: CNY. Unit: cent
parameters.help_zh:
用餐额度
货币：人民币，单位：分
parameters.name: meal_amount

parameters.help_en: The internal invoice header ID of Alibaba Business Travel. Specify either this parameter or the third-party invoice header ID
parameters.help_zh: 商旅内部发票抬头Id，和第三方发票抬头Id 二者选择其一即可
parameters.name: invoice_id

parameters.help_en: The third-party invoice header ID. Specify either this parameter or the internal invoice header ID of Alibaba Business Travel
parameters.help_zh: 三方发票抬头Id，和商旅发票抬头Id 二者选择其一即可
parameters.name: third_part_invoice_id

parameters.help_en: The internal cost center ID of Alibaba Business Travel associated with the application form. Specify either this parameter or the third-party cost center ID
parameters.help_zh: 申请单关联的商旅内部成本中心Id，和第三方成本中心Id 二者选择其一即可
parameters.name: cost_center_id

parameters.help_en: The third-party cost center ID associated with the application form. Specify either this parameter or the internal cost center ID of Alibaba Business Travel
parameters.help_zh: 申请单关联的三方成本中心Id，和商旅成本中心Id 二者选择其一即可
parameters.name: third_part_cost_center_id

parameters.help_en:
The extended information.

You can pass supplementary descriptions to this field, and the corresponding content will be reflected in the bill. This field is generally used for corporate travel statistics and reconciliation
parameters.help_zh:
扩展信息。

可将补充描述传入此字段，账单中将会体现对应内容。一般可以用于企业差旅统计和对账
parameters.name: extend_field

parameters.help_en: The header parameter. Obtain this parameter from the "Enterprise access credentials" operation and add it to the header. In HTTP mode, you can use corp_token=value in the URL instead
parameters.help_zh: header参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

third_party_apply_id.description_en: The ID of the third-party application form

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
